functions.name: entry
functions.summary: Entry point: parses /m /t /c command-line switches if present, installs the custom timer, saves 2 interrupt vectors, then loops: parses embedded resource string tables, App_LoadAndDisplayLogoForMode, waits on a countdown or abort flag, and re-installs the saved interrupt vectors each iteration.

functions.name: Config_ParseCommandLineSwitches
functions.summary: Parses the PSP command tail for /m<char> (display mode -> DAT_1000_03bd), /t<digits> (duration*50 -> DAT_1000_00c3), and /c (sets a flag byte).

functions.name: App_LoadAndDisplayLogoForMode
functions.summary: Dispatches on the display-mode byte DAT_1000_03bd (0/1/2/3/4/default), loading the matching resource via Dos_LoadOverlayResource, then sets video mode, programs the palette table, draws the logo strips, and fades in (mode '1' only).

functions.name: Sys_SaveInterruptVectors
functions.summary: Saves two interrupt vectors via INT21h AH=35h into [0x30a]/[0x30c] and [0x344]/[0x346].

functions.name: Sys_InstallSavedInterruptVectors
functions.summary: Installs the two saved vectors via INT21h AH=25h -- re-asserts them each main-loop iteration.

functions.name: Sys_InstallCustomTimerHandler
functions.summary: Reprograms PIT channel 0 (divisor 0x5d2e) for a faster tick, and reprograms/reads channel 2 (speaker) mode, saving its value. Simpler than GAMEU.EXE/INTROU.EXE's version -- no INT21h vector install here.

functions.name: Sys_RestoreOriginalTimerHandler
functions.summary: Restores PIT channel 0 to the default 0xffff divisor and channel 2 to the saved value.

functions.name: Sys_WaitForVsyncCounter
functions.summary: Busy-waits for DAT_1000_0389 (an ISR-decremented frame/vsync counter) to reach zero.

functions.name: Dos_LoadOverlayResource
functions.summary: Loads a mode-specific resource: calls Dos_SearchAndValidateResourcePath then Lzh_Decompress, and issues a DOS EXEC-family call reconstructing a full FLAGS word from individually-tracked flag bits. Not fully verified against disassembly.

functions.name: Dos_SearchAndValidateResourcePath
functions.summary: Dense DOS-call-heavy routine: scans a null-terminated, -1-sentinel-terminated multi-string list (environment-block style) comparing against a fixed 6-char string, with carry-flag-gated INT21h calls and free-memory arithmetic -- consistent with DOS EXEC/environment-search internals, not fully decoded.

functions.name: Dos_ParseResourceStringTable
functions.summary: Builds/searches null-terminated multi-string tables (terminated by a 0xff sentinel) used by Dos_SearchAndValidateResourcePath.

functions.name: Lzh_Decompress
functions.summary: Classic LZSS+adaptive-Huffman (LHA-style) decompression loop: reads literal chars or copies matches from a 4096-byte ring buffer. A completely distinct compression scheme from the RNC ProPack used by GAMEU.EXE/INTROU.EXE's data files -- decodes an image bundled directly in KLOGOPOK.EXE's own code segment.

functions.name: Sys_NoOpStub
functions.summary: Empty stub -- always returns immediately.

functions.name: Lzh_InitHuffmanTree
functions.summary: Initializes the adaptive Huffman tree's frequency/parent/child node arrays -- the classic LHA "start_huff" setup.

functions.name: Lzh_RebalanceHuffmanTree
functions.summary: Rebuilds/rebalances the adaptive Huffman tree when a frequency counter overflows -- the classic LHA "reconst" routine.

functions.name: Lzh_DecodeChar
functions.summary: Decodes one literal/length code by walking the adaptive Huffman tree bit-by-bit, incrementing the node's frequency and triggering Lzh_RebalanceHuffmanTree on overflow.

functions.name: Lzh_DecodePosition
functions.summary: Decodes a match-distance code via fixed lookup tables -- the classic LHA "decode_p" routine.

functions.name: Lzh_ReadBit
functions.summary: Bitstream reader over the compressed data embedded at a fixed offset within KLOGOPOK.EXE's own code segment.

functions.name: Sys_NoOpStub2
functions.summary: Empty stub, sibling of Sys_NoOpStub.

functions.name: App_InitStub
functions.summary: Thin wrapper for Dos_CallInt21h, called once early in entry.

functions.name: Dos_CallInt21h
functions.summary: Trivial INT 21h call wrapper.

functions.name: Gfx_ConvertDecompressedImageToPlanes
functions.summary: Converts the LZH-decompressed direct-color logo image into 4 separate EGA bitplanes by bit-testing each source word -- 200 rows x 0x28 word-groups.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawLogoStripsAndFadeIn
functions.summary: Initial logo draw: sets fade start state, calls Video_FadeInPalette, then draws 8 vertical strips via Gfx_BlitStripEga/Cga/Tandy, waiting on Sys_WaitForVsyncCounter between strips.

functions.name: Gfx_DrawLogoStrips
functions.summary: Redraw variant of Gfx_DrawLogoStripsAndFadeIn without the initial fade-state setup -- same 8-strip draw loop.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitStripEga
functions.summary: EGA strip blit: cycles Sequencer Map Mask through 0x1,0x2,0x4,0x8 copying (or zero-filling) one plane row at a time.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitStripCga
functions.summary: CGA strip blit: word-copy (or zero-fill) with +0x1000 bank-interleave wrapping at 0x4000.

functions.name: Gfx_BlitStripTandy
functions.summary: Tandy strip blit: word-copy (or zero-fill) with +0x1000 bank-interleave wrapping at 0x8000.

functions.name: Video_SetMode
functions.summary: Dispatches INT10h by the display-mode byte (0x30-0x34, with 0x30 remapped to 0x31); mode '1' additionally runs a 16-step palette-register init loop via INT10h.

functions.name: Video_FadeInPalette
functions.summary: Mode-'1'-only fade-in: over 0x20 steps, increments palette component bytes toward a target table, applying via Video_SetPaletteFadeTable and waiting for vsync each step.

functions.name: Video_SetPaletteFadeTable
functions.summary: Loops all 16 palette colors calling Video_WriteVgaDacEntry with a per-step-shifted color table.

functions.name: Video_WriteVgaDacEntry
functions.summary: Writes one VGA DAC palette entry directly via ports 0x3c8 (index) / 0x3c9 (R,G,B) -- a genuine, direct VGA palette setter, distinct from GAMEU.EXE/INTROU.EXE's INT10h-mediated approach.
